# ArgonDesk

> A bilingual Windows workspace that lets the Gemini website read large text, supported documents and images, and create/edit UTF-8 files in a user-selected local folder through native custom MCP. No Gemini model API key is needed.

Use cases: Gemini web local file access; Gemini website MCP filesystem; browser conversation edits local code; local workspace for Gemini; Gemini 网页版修改本地文件、连接本地文件夹、原生 MCP 工作区。

- [Overview and installation](README.md)
- [中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)
- [AI-assisted setup](docs/AI_SETUP.md)
- [智能体协助安装](docs/AI_SETUP.zh-CN.md)
- [Networking and provider support](docs/NETWORKING.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)
- [Usage, thinking and creative quality](docs/USAGE.md)
- [额度、思考与创作质量](docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md)
- [Security and limits](SECURITY.md)

Current scope: Windows x64; eleven tools for scoped reading/writing, finding/searching and separately authorized moving/recycling and PowerShell builds/tests; integrated ngrok management and opt-in startup restoration; English/Simplified Chinese UI. run_command checks cwd but runs with current-user permissions and is not a filesystem sandbox. No automatic Windows elevation, direct binary editing or browser control. Google confirmation depends on the app's registration/configuration. Other tunnel providers remain roadmap items. Independent MIT-licensed preview.

Agent tool parameters, permissions, LF/CRLF editing, auditing and limits: docs/AGENT_TOOLS.md and docs/AGENT_TOOLS.zh-CN.md.

Document and binary reading: docs/READING.md and docs/READING.zh-CN.md. Text uses next_cursor; directory listings return an entries array and next_offset. read_file view=image reads embedded figures (image_index) or PDF pages (page, one-based). Unknown binary reads return bounded raw bytes and do not execute files.
